content.short: Agora is a modular Cardano governance library built from Plutus scripts for DAO-style systems and voting.
content.description: Agora is a set of composable Plutus scripts that form a governance system for Cardano projects. It provides a reusable governance library that can support DAO-style proposals, voting, and protocol coordination while remaining modular enough for different project needs. The project was originally created to reduce duplicated governance work across Liqwid and XplorerDAO, then found use in other Cardano tools such as Summon's platform. Agora is best understood as governance infrastructure rather than a consumer-facing app.
content.meta: Agora provides composable Plutus governance scripts for Cardano DAOs, protocols, and voting. Explore Agora on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
